messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Churn sentinel: ClearWave renewal forecasting & action items

Amanda / Chris —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. I pulled a short set of signals that suggest the account is at elevated churn risk heading into the Jan renewal window and wanted to align on concrete next steps so Finance and Sales have a shared forecast. High-level: usage down 27% M/M across two product lines, one invoice (1345) has a billing variance, and procurement has signaled an internal freeze which could delay sign-off.

What I'm proposing:
- Confirm current renewal target (baseline ARR) and whether they will be renewing both modules by 2029-01-31.
- Marissa / Ben: quick stage update in HubSpot to either "At Risk - Procurement" or "Commit - Pending PO" by EOD Thurs.
- David: can you validate invoice 1345 and advise if we can offer a one-time credit to smooth the reconciliation?
- Amanda: please add a short procurement timeline (expected PO date + approvers) — that will feed the mutual action plan.

I've attached the usage trend CSV and a mutual action plan draft. If we can get those five datapoints by Friday we'll update the forecast and set a single-step mitigation (10% one-time credit if customer signs by 2028-12-15).

Attachments: clearwave-usage-trend.csv, mutual-action-plan.docx

Thanks —
Naomi

Naomi —

Thanks for the quick summary and the data. Internal note: our Q1 budget review pushed several renewals into procurement backlog. We're targeting 2028-12-20 for an internal approval, but there is a chance the PO slips into January. The delay is driven by a headcount freeze + priority reallocation.

I'll upload a procurement timeline PDF to share the approvers and when they meet (attached). We value the relationship — the usage drop is related to a slow rollout on our side (project resourcing) rather than product dissatisfaction.

If Redwood can commit to a small reconciliation credit that offsets the billing variance, that will materially help approval. I can share who the budget approver is once the 12/20 meeting occurs.

Best,

Thanks — I've reviewed invoice 1345 and found a mismatch: we billed for 2 seats of the Analytics module in Sep but ClearWave registered a contract amendment showing 1 seat effective 2028-09-01. The supporting amendment wasn't processed in our billing system.

Options:
1) Issue a corrective credit for the overbilled month and apply a $4,500 credit toward the renewal if they commit by 2028-12-15.
2) Defer credit decision until the PO is in hand; offer expedited reconciliation and a one-time service credit if the contract is executed by 2029-01-31.

Financial impact: option 1 reduces near-term ARR recognition by ~$4.5k but materially reduces churn risk; option 2 keeps revenue intact until close but may not influence approval.

I've attached a short reconciliation workbook. If Sales prefers option 1 as part of a mitigation package, we should log the credit in the fin-ops tracker and update the forecast for Q1.

Attachment: invoice-1345-discrepancy.xlsx

-David

david@redwood.com
